purpose: Measure real workload incidence during a later separately authorized, already protected lifecycle without purchasing a parallel baseline
dependencies: Complete authenticated first-owner protection and financial/recovery acceptance
Separate authorization for the underlying operating lifecycle and its provider resource/dollar budget
Existing purchase counters, native journals and canonical evidence archives remain the sources
sources: Existing native journals and evidence archives, read-only
Redacted owner Admin usage export for the same application and capture window

envelope.underlying_lifecycle_provider_budget: Separately required; not authorized or priced by this specification

procedure: Retain start/end snapshots of existing fixed-domain counters and original native decisions; reuse existing archives
Separate no-position discovery, held acquisition, valuation, sender/receipt history, retries/recovery and stream delivery
Record actual block advancement, uncovered intervals, new relevant transaction cardinality, cache reuse/invalidation and decision deadlines where existing receipts expose them
Keep unknown or unattributed components unknown; do not create a price or safety observation from missing data
Replay the same retained canonical market evidence offline against published original and optimized code; never run a second paid native acquisition
Report additional sampling CPU/disk/latency and abandon optional collection if it could impede protection
Reconcile method CU and delivery with the applicable authenticated tariff/account export; distinguish model from invoice
Publish only bounded-window measured incidence; keep monthly expected utilization unknown until representative evidence exists
stop_conditions: Sampling duration, artifact or counter-row bound reached
Optional extraction would need a provider call, reconstruction request, new stream, write to native state or strategy action
Protection, maintenance, storage headroom or logging availability would be impaired
Evidence coverage/source identity cannot support an equivalent offline replay
safety: Stopping optional sampling never sells a position or stops existing native protection. PAPER remains stopped/disabled now. No new sampler service or diagnostic purchase is implemented.
